E1b-08 opened. load_limits.py (written and run now, output load_limits.json). Load-bearing: every stage from A1 to D6 has outputs a later stage names in its commands or reads (A1 13 of 20, B1 15 of 25, B2 18 of 61, B3 11 of 1,266, B4 10 of 146, C1 6 of 16, C2 15 of 37, C3 4 of 9, C4 6 of 10, C5 13 of 74, D1 54 of 722, D2 4 of 7, D3 4 of 23, D4 20 of 70, D5 11 of 48, D6 7 of 271); the files no later stage names are mostly packets, superseded copies, answers, notes and handbacks, which fleets, tools or the harness read without naming them in a command, so the test cannot call them unread; by hand, some look read by nothing: lexicon-A1.md, leads-outside-frame-A1.jsonl, ideas-B1.jsonl, kinds-B1.jsonl, form_pass-C1.md, gate_history.jsonl, within_case.md, sketches.md, author_claims.jsonl (not checked against every tool's inputs). tools/chunk_compare.py's sha256 now equals the receipt in departures.jsonl (chunk-comparison-v1.1, c8d2eb8c7c309c02), and its outputs (chunk-share-D4.jsonl and .md, projections-D4.jsonl) are present, so a stranger can rerun it; I did not rerun it. The data-structure view moved between C2's last snap (57f68644867d) and C5's (c4a4c4884570) and is unchanged since; data_structure-C5.md is present. The dimensions: named by id in 44 lines of model/elements.jsonl and by name in propositions.jsonl (14 times, as levels) and retelling-D6.md (its parts), weighted 1.0 in D4's distance; named in no line of branches.jsonl, branches-D5.jsonl, model/arrows.jsonl or account.md. So the dimension tier sorts the elements and the propositions' levels and weighs in the distance, but does no work in the account's argument, the arrows or the branches' keys. Limits: coder_conflicts.jsonl 72 lines; arrows no proposition rests on: A21; third-order themes no standing element reaches: 35 of 195; absence findings: F-015 (weak).

E1b-08 the limits and the shelf. The critique shelf's four read-tier files: Jowsey et al. 2025 and the call for papers read whole; O'Sullivan and Ravasi 2026 and Schildt 2026 searched by the objections' terms with their pages (shelf_terms.py, written and run now, output shelf_terms.json), not read whole, a limit. Their objections and pages: invented quotes (O'Sullivan and Ravasi p. 16; Schildt pp. 1, 4); the reasoning handed to the machine, cognitive offloading (Schildt p. 1; O'Sullivan and Ravasi p. 2); an opaque process (O'Sullivan and Ravasi p. 17; Schildt's title, p. 1); the craft and reflexivity a model does not have (Jowsey et al. pp. 1-2; O'Sullivan and Ravasi p. 13; Schildt p. 14); more output instead of better (the call, p. 1; Schildt pp. 1-2); and Jowsey et al.'s harms to the environment and to data workers (p. 2). The size confound: D4's volume verdict (notes-D4.md line 114) has the cluster labels explaining 0.255 of the variance in log concepts, at the 100th percentile of the permutation null (null maximum 0.026). Overturning, by computation: with 686 of 705 rooms composing at the re-check (0.973), a stratified sample of 30 uncoded rooms in which 4 or more do not compose (tail p 0.0083), or 6 or more of 60 (0.0055), would set the uncoded rooms apart from the coded population. leads-outside-frame-A1.jsonl names 2 rooms outside the frame.
